description_en: Retrieves the parallel paths of uplink data packets for a node by calling ListNodeTransferPacketPaths
description_zh: 调用ListNodeTransferPacketPaths获取节点上行数据包的平行路径
name: ListNodeTransferPacketPaths

parameters.help_en: The MacPayload of the data packet. Obtain this value from the response of the ListNodeGroupTransferPackets operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据包的MacPayload，由ListNodeGroupTransferPackets接口的返回值获取
parameters.name: base64_encoded_mac_payload

parameters.help_en: The time when the data packet was received. Obtain this value from the response of the ListNodeGroupTransferPackets operation
parameters.help_zh: 收到此数据包的时间，由ListNodeGroupTransferPackets的返回值获取
parameters.name: log_millis

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.name: page_size
